market_view: VIX is calm at 15.7 but the 10-year yield hit a high of 5.16 and the dollar is firm; oil is falling on US-Iran peace talk headlines and gold is weak. Mixed picture with no clear stock-specific catalyst.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI fell from 101.9 to about 94 and peace-talk headlines point lower, but XOM is flat and the oil move is already in the price. No dated XOM catalyst; Q3 earnings only in late October.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is down 7.6% in 20 days, the 10-year yield is at a high of 5.16, the dollar is firm and KGC fell 11.6%. Jobs report adds variance only. No concrete reason for a long.

chips.reasoning: The sector is up 7% in 5 days; headlines are generic (Oracle force majeure worry, memory weakness). No dated NVDA catalyst. A rally already in the price is not a reason.

pharma.reasoning: LLY +2.7% on minor approval news (Olumiant pediatric); drug-pricing policy remains an overhang. No edge.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is steady but FCX is down 8.8% in 20 days; the BHP Chile mine halt is a modest supply headline, not clearly reaching FCX. Uranium is weak. No concrete reason.

would_change_my_mind: A dated, named company catalyst or a clear policy or supply shock that has not yet moved the stock.

handoff.what_changed: WTI fell to 94.6 (from 101.9) on US-Iran peace-talk headlines while XOM stayed flat; the 10-year yield rose to a high of 5.16 and gold slid to about 4,298 (-7.6% in 20 days). Chips rose 7% in 5 days (AMD at a high); VIX is 15.7.

oil_gas.why: WTI is falling on peace talks, XOM has not followed, and there is no dated catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Yields at a high and a firm dollar weigh on gold; no concrete reason for a long.

chips.why: Strong 5-day rally already priced in; headlines are generic.

pharma.why: LLY approval is minor and pricing policy is an overhang; no edge.

copper_uranium.why: BHP Chile halt is a modest headline; FCX weak over 20 days and uranium falling; no edge.
